import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
destination = Path('products/services/catalogue-text-fulfillment/runner-diagnostic.json')
script_names = {'verify_example.py', 'transform.py'}
scripts = sorted(path for path in site.rglob('*.py') if path.name in script_names)
records = []
for script in scripts:
    arguments = [sys.executable, script.name]
    if script.name == 'transform.py':
        arguments.append('--help')
    result = subprocess.run(arguments, cwd=script.parent, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    records.append({'path': str(script), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'argv': arguments, 'cwd': str(script.parent), 'returncode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
report = {'scope': 'Offline runner diagnostic. No customer delivery or order.', 'runs': records, 'missing_scripts': sorted(script_names - {script.name for script in scripts}), 'csv_paths': [str(path) for path in sorted(site.rglob('*.csv'))]}
destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
destination.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(destination.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
